name: superairdrop
description: AirDrop-style file sharing between Samsung/Android and iPhone in the browser, with resumable, checksum-verified transfers.

scripts.cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 825 -subj '/CN=superairdrop.local' -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem
